subject.title: Bug: partialArgs JSON duplication in agentTurn cron jobs with isolated sessionTarget

question: Should OpenClaw repair duplicated complete tool-call argument JSON only when the repeated objects are semantically identical, or continue failing closed until live provider proof justifies broader recovery?
rationale: The unresolved choice affects whether malformed tool-call payload recovery can silently change file or command tool arguments, which is a product and safety boundary rather than a mechanical parser tweak.

options.title: Repair identical duplicates only
options.body: Allow recovery when all concatenated complete JSON objects are semantically equal, but fail closed when any suffix object differs or cannot be proven duplicate.

options.title: Require broader live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers gather provider traces showing whether non-identical suffixes have a legitimate recoverable shape.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject duplicated structured suffixes as malformed and close or park the candidate PR until a safer contract is defined.

recommendation.title: Repair identical duplicates only
recommendation.body: Allow recovery when all concatenated complete JSON objects are semantically equal, but fail closed when any suffix object differs or cannot be proven duplicate.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the malformed tool-call argument repair path and related hardening decisions.
